deliverables.writtenCompanion:
Late finishes and reversals shaped Saturday’s sports results. Cleveland defeated the Chicago White Sox 2–0 in the deciding game of their American League Division Series, completing a comeback after losing the first two games. José Ramírez’s two-run home run provided the scoring.

In college football, Oklahoma defeated top-ranked Texas 27–24 with a field goal as time expired. Indiana beat Nebraska 20–17 after trailing 17–6 in the fourth quarter. Kentucky defeated LSU 35–34 in overtime.

These results offer different local leads. Cleveland’s edition centres on advancing after a series deficit. Chicago’s edition centres on the end of the White Sox’s postseason. Indiana’s edition centres on the Hoosiers’ fourth-quarter rally. Each version should retain the same scores and distinguish fact from commentary.

This internal rehearsal uses historical results from October 10, 2026. It is not a current sports bulletin and includes no licensed event footage.
